name: numeric-conditions
description: Tests that constraint modifier conditions of type lessThan, greaterThan, and equalTo correctly evaluate and apply their modifiers.

rosters.description: The equalTo condition is met, so the max selection limit is incremented from 1 to 2, preventing a violation with 2 selected items.
The equalTo condition is NOT met, so the max selection limit remains 1, causing a violation with 2 selected items.
The greaterThan condition is met, so the max selection limit is changed from 0 to -1 (unlimited), preventing a violation with 1 selected item.
The greaterThan condition is NOT met, so the max selection limit remains 0, causing a violation with 1 selected item.
The lessThan condition is met, so the min selection limit is reduced from 1 to 0, preventing a violation when the item is omitted (0 selected).
The lessThan condition is NOT met, so the min selection limit remains 1, causing a violation when the item is omitted (0 selected).
